facts.fact: The page is dated as published on April 20, 2026.
Red Pin Geek's guide for product-based businesses recommends using the Pinterest search bar to find 5 to 10 primary keywords per product category.
facts.quote: using the Pinterest search bar to find 5 to 10 primary keywords per product category

facts.fact: Red Pin Geek's guide for product-based businesses recommends maintaining at least five fresh pins daily.
facts.quote: maintaining at least five fresh pins daily

facts.fact: Red Pin Geek's guide for product-based businesses recommends designing pins in a vertical 1000x1500 format.
facts.quote: designing pins in a vertical 1000x1500 format

facts.fact: Red Pin Geek states that visual content is 40x more likely to be shared (a third-party claim cited by AdWave, not AdWave's own data).
facts.unit: x more likely to be shared
facts.quote: Visual content is also noted as 40x more likely to be shared

facts.fact: A 2025 Pinterest report, as cited by Great Scott Social (a third-party source, not Adwave), noted that 80% of users discovered new brands that led to physical store visits.
facts.quote: a 2025 Pinterest report noted that 80% of users discovered new brands that led to physical store visits

facts.fact: According to the page, Shopping Ads are better than Promoted Pins when a catalog is healthy and the advertiser wants Pinterest to serve products directly from synced inventory.
facts.quote: Shopping Ads are better when your catalog is healthy and you want Pinterest to serve products directly from synced inventory.

facts.fact: The page recommends using UTM parameters on destination URLs so Google Analytics can separate Pinterest traffic by board, theme, campaign, or creative angle.
facts.quote: Use UTM parameters on destination URLs so Google Analytics can separate traffic by board, theme, campaign, or creative angle.
